decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management sits very close to BSM's core ship management knowledge and serves the growing offshore renewables market, so the firm can readily interpret results and keep improving the unit.
Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's large crewing operations and administrative expertise, giving it strong absorptive capacity to run and refine the service.

An online vessel information portal extends the firm's operational data and client reporting into digital form, and its existing vessel knowledge helps it learn from user feedback, although digital competencies are less core.

A mobile performance app draws on the firm's vessel operations know-how and fits its sustainability goals, but it relies on software skills further from its core and may be merged into other digital tools, which makes it the riskiest product.
